name: Heirs of Denesfield
source: "Heirs of Denesfield" is a charming, linear visual novel based on Ruth Lamb's short story titled "Aunt Milly’s Diamonds." This Christmas-centered, Christian tale has been updated for today's audience and woven with a charming romance between the main characters to add an extra layer of engagement.
